name: Lifters and draggers
answers: Which exact segments help and hurt?
shape: top and bottom [n] segments across [depth]-way cuts on [measure]
caveat: Segments in the thinnest quartile by bookers are dropped so per-day extremes are not noise.
explain: Segments ranked by lift, top N positive and top N negative, with booker counts and all three metrics; segments under `min_bookers` are dropped, the thinnest quartile is trimmed when `trim_quartile` is on, and each row's Z-test says whether its lift clears the `confidence_bar`.
